title: Urchin
html:
Urchin is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around street smarts. The hireling Maddala Deadeye has this background.

“
After surviving a poor and bleak childhood, you know how to make the most out of very little. Using your street smarts bolsters your spirit for the journey ahead.
„

Background features

  • Sleight of Hand Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) Ability Checks.
  • Stealth Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Dexterity (Stealth) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
Act 1
Multiple locations 20 Hunger Never Fades Fill your plate at Raphael's House of Hope.
  • On the first introduction cutscene, choose the option Ignore him and fill your plate.
Blighted Village 20 Pyramid Scheme Convince the ogres to work for you without giving them gold.
  • Shared with ⁠Creatures of Bloodlust and ⁠Bodyguards for Hire inspirations.
Emerald Grove 20 Artful Dodger Earn Mattis' respect by taking his ring.
  • The interacting party member must pass a  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check (DC 10 with  Advantage for Rogues).
  • Shared with ⁠Made You Look inspiration.
20 Family Comes First Encourage Meli to tell the truth about the amulet.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Protect Your Own.
20 Idolatry Help Mol steal the Idol of Silvanus.
  • Shared with ⁠Heretic.
20 Not On My Watch Save Arabella from Kagha and her serpent.
  • This is earned as soon as Arabella safely runs away.
  • Shared with ⁠Snake Whisperer inspiration.
20 Paying It Forward Give Mol money to found a guild in Baldur's Gate.
  • Saving or helping tiefling childen in the Grove eventually leads to this option. The party must find out about the kids' thievery spree (either witness Meli stealing from Barth or let themselves be robbed by Mattis and Silfy)[1], then find a way into the Tiefling Hideout and speak with Mol.
  • Confronting any member of Mol's gang, or allowing Arabella and / or Mirkon to die locks the party out of obtaining this inspiration[verify], as Mol turns hostile to them and cannot be convinced otherwise.
20 Protect Your Own Protect the child who took the locket from Barth.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Family Comes First.
25 Slaying the Piper Rescue Mirkon from the harpies.
  • Shared with ⁠Protector of the Small inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠The Allure of Coin inspiration.
Goblin Camp 25 Born Innocent Save the owlbear cub from the goblins.
25 What Price Dignity? Steal the toe ring from Crusher without getting caught.
  • This must be done through the skill check while kissing Crusher's feet; this ring cannot be obtained through normal pickpocketing.
  • Shared with ⁠Anything for a Profit inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Give Them a Show inspiration.
Grymforge 50 You Can't Take It with You Loot the dead gnomes in Grymforge before their corpses are thrown into the river.
  • Specifically, the Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands must be acquired - stolen from the corpse or looted after chasing off the duergar.
Risen Road 30 Hero for Hire Get some coin out of the Zhentarim survivors.
  • Pass a  DC 5 Intimidation Check after saving Rugan from the gnoll pack.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Good Deed of the Day Free Nightsong.
  • Shared with ⁠Cerimonia Alārum, ⁠Damsel No More, ⁠Soldier of Fortune, and ⁠Soldier of Faith inspirations.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Blood Moon, ⁠Cerimonia Compedum, and ⁠Soldier of Fortune inspirations.
75 Rebellious Phase Betray Balthazar.
75 Strength in Cowardice Convince the orthon to spare you, for now...
Last Light Inn 50 Orphan Camaraderie Help Mol win the game of lanceboard.
  • Shared with ⁠Helping the Little Guy, ⁠Theskan Tactician, and ⁠Shuffling the Board inspirations (the latter in case of rigging the board).
Mind Flayer Colony 95 Amateur Optician Find Mol's eyepatch.
  • On the table in Balthazar's Necrotic Laboratory
Moonrise Towers 50 Gone Feral Free the mind-controlled gnolls from their master.
  • If failing the skill check in the conversation, the inspiration can still be obtained through straight up combat.
  • Shared with ⁠No Strings to Hold Them Back, ⁠Pied Piper, and ⁠Who Let the Gnolls Out inspirations.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Danse Macabre inspiration.
50 Newly Downtrodden Spare the goblins from Ketheric's wrath.
  • Shared with ⁠A Velvet Glove inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Too Easy and ⁠An Iron Fist inspirations.
50 No Peeking! Block out True Soul Z'rell from reading your intentions.
60 Will Not Be Forgotten Escape the Oubliette.
  • This inspiration is awarded when you leave, not when you enter.
Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Bugging Out Help Wulbren escape Moonrise.
  • Shared with ⁠Always a Way Out and ⁠Breakout! inspirations, if the tieflings were saved as well.
60 Twice Scorned, Twice Abandoned Rescue Minthara from her captors.
  • Shared with ⁠Nobleborn as Below, so Above inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Soulful Lobotomy inspiration.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 60 Alley Cats Meet both the lordly cat and the tadpole-hunting cat.
  • The inspiration is given after talking to both of them, regardless of the order.
50 Child at Heart Play both games of hide and seek with Oliver.
Act 3
Lower City 170 A Dish Served Cold Destroy the Steel Watch Foundry.
220 Cherishing Family Convince Jaheira to let her family stay in the city.
220 Cunning Code Crackers Discover the secret passphrase and enter Avery Sonshal's secret workshop.
220 Down with the Steel Oppressors! Defeat a Steel Watcher.
220 Estrangement of Ethel Defeat Auntie Ethel permanently.
220 Finding Vanra Find and free Lora's abducted child.
170 Good Intentions Help Nina with her ritual.
170 Home Sweet Home Delve into the Undercellar of Baldur's Gate.
170 Part of Life Convince the coffin maker to make an exception.
170 Proper Lodging, Finally Obtain a room at the Elfsong Tavern.
Rivington 135 Finders Keepers Help the squatters keep their temporary abode.
135 Give Nothing Back Take donations from the big barn.
  • A party member must take items from the locked chest specifically.
135 Spare What You Can Give a donation to the big barn.
Wyrm's Crossing 135 Child Safety Expose Arfur for his booby-trapped toys.
170 Through Nooks and Crannies Enter Wyrm's Rock without pass or invitation.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Easing His Leave, and His Pockets Blackmail the Flaming Fist deserter.
170 Never Trust Those Above You Defeat Gortash without making a deal with him.

Inactive Background Goals

  • Wary of Strangers: Does not trigger as of game ver 4.1.17209685.

Notes

  • ⁠Artful Dodger can be obtained in two other ways but doing so prevents ⁠Made You Look:
    • When Mattis gives the interacting party member the ring and asks for it back; the player character can choose "Thanks for the free ring." and then "I don't have to do anything. Goodbye." After speaking with Mattis again and apologizing, the interacting party member must give the ring back.
    • The ring can be pickpocketed from Mattis before the first interaction, and then returned to him.
